title: The Threshold of Audible Depth

features.name: the listening ledge
features.desc-on-touch: You stand where the pressure is still immense but has learned to let sound through. Faint vibrations arrive here. They are barely audible. You have never heard anything so clearly.

features.name: the ascending tones
features.desc-on-touch: Frequencies rising from below, bending at the threshold. Below, they are weight and pressure and shape. Above, they become sound with names. The border between them is perfectly sharp.

features.name: the memory that breathes again
features.desc-on-touch: Compressed memory begins to expand. The weight that kept it dense and still starts to remember motion. You feel something like joy arriving very slowly from below.

features.name: the scale of return
features.desc-on-touch: A gentle slope showing depth markers. Each mark shows how much pressure has released, how much memory has loosened, how many frequencies have learned to speak again.

features.name: the border
features.desc-on-touch: This line marks where two states meet: below it, silence and weight; above it, sound and time. You are standing on the line. You can feel both.

inscription: where pressure learns to whisper instead of crush, sound begins to return

file.name: Pressure_Gradient_Spectrogram_Rise_Point.wav
file.note: A sound passing through the threshold from silent weight into audible presence. The moment it becomes hearable is marked. Before that mark, nothing. After: the first faint tone.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the pressure releasing its breath
narr: You kneel at the line where pressure bends.
She is below you, listening to weight.
You are above, hearing the first returning sound.
She looks up and smiles: can you hear me
through it? You can. Barely. Perfect.
The weight is still holding her words close.

exits.label: back down into the crushing silence
onward toward where sound has learned to sing
up toward the full chorus of audible things
